registry.name: A.T.E. Chandra Foundation desilting, Pune and Amravati (pilot extract)
registry.source: Pilot extract of swb:waterbodies_atecf_mh_pune_189 and swb:waterbodies_atecf_mh_amravati_170 read through a browser on 27 Nov 2026: one point per record at the source polygon centre; some 2025-26 records left out. Replace with the full registry from impact-build-registry.
registry.year_convention: Hydrological years start in June and are named by their first calendar year (2023 = 2023-24). Work is done before the monsoon, so an intervention in year Y has Y, Y+1, ... as post years and Y-1 and earlier as pre years.
